hazards.evidence: The hallway forming the bed-to-bathroom route is dimly lit.
A chair, pet bed, bowl, and toy clutter the floor beside and at the foot of the bed.
The chair and pet items substantially reduce walker clearance around the bed.
A loose area rug with a visible raised edge lies in the walking area at the foot of the bed.
The route around the bed is narrowed by a wooden chair and pet supplies.
A pet bed, food bowl, and toy are directly in the walking path beside the bed.
